primary.title: Performance-linked mutual fund fee vs TER: How SEBI’s new model works and why fund houses are hesitant
primary.summary: SEBI has proposed a performance-based fee framework for mutual funds, linking fees to a fund's performance rather than a fixed ratio. However, industry hesitance stems from operational challenges and complexities associated with variable fee structures.
